### DISC-1: "12 hardcoded tools" vs 5-entry TOOLS catalog [Low]
- **Ticket says:** Chatbox exposes 12 hardcoded tools.
- **Actual codebase:** tool-definitions.ts TOOLS has 5 entries (4 concrete + execute_dynamic_tool); the observed ~12-name legacy pool = builtin workspace tools (createWorkspaceTools) + ext tools (getPiExtensionAgentTools) + bridge tools once compiled.
- **Impact:** None on design — TDD §2.1 documents the real composition; DEV must not go looking for a 12-entry array.
- **Recommended fix:** No ticket change needed; informational.

### DISC-2: "TOOL_ALLOWLIST only 4 tools" framed as defect [Low]
- **Ticket says:** Allowlist of 4 tools is part of the bug.
- **Actual codebase:** TOOL_ALLOWLIST governs chained targets of execute_dynamic_tool only (validateChainedTarget), by design per SEC-324-03; build-time emission is NOT allowlist-filtered.
- **Impact:** None — TDD keeps the 4-target allowlist unchanged (§7 S-6); extending it needs separate security review.
- **Recommended fix:** No ticket change needed; informational.
